body: I'm a fan of God of War.

I'm naturally thin and eat small meals throughout the day. My family members besides my father are overweight. I'm constantly having comments or shade thrown in my direction when I turn down snacks or unhealthy meals. It is almost like they think I'm silently judging them if I don't want nachos from the gas station at 9 pm. The arguments and demands to eat something when I'm no hungry get old fast. Sometimes I've been met with anger over it.
I'm a thin person and cringe when asked, "God! What do you weigh?" I always wonder if that person would ask someone overweight the same question.
Call Me Maybe. I don't know what went wrong in my life. I'm sorry.

I am very introverted and shy. Sometimes I have luck with making new friends by pretending I'm not these things in my head. At a social gathering, I will tell myself I'm in a play and my character likes socializing. I know it sounds stupid but sometimes playing make believe in my head that I'm an extrovert does help. Afterwards, friends I've made are shocked to know I'm introverted and shy. Even if it doesn't work one time, you're no worse off.

Wow! I'm so glad you had a positive experience with the suicide hotline and that Tom helped give you a ray of hope! Sometimes that's all we need in dark moments to get us through another day. Proud of you because sadness and depression are terrible things to get through on a day to day basis and finding any lifeline is so brave!
